title: Threat Matrix Assessment Output
description: Constrained output contract for the threat-matrix inference layer. Designed so that licensed source data CANNOT be reproduced in the artifact: there is no field capable of holding an event count, a per-event record, a date-stamped incident, or a per-location tally. Non-transformative output is structurally impossible rather than merely discouraged. Source datasets are named in provenance; they are never reproduced in the body.

label.description: Human-readable area of interest, e.g. "Cabinda, Angola".

judgment.description: Analytical prose. MUST NOT contain event counts, incident dates, casualty figures, or per-location tallies drawn from licensed source data. State pattern, driver, and implication — not the underlying records.

items.description: Qualitative driver. Same prohibition as judgment.
Forward-looking signal that would change this assessment.

bottom_line.description: BLUF synthesis across dimensions. Same prohibition on reproducing source records.

provenance.description: Names the inputs without reproducing them. This is the attribution surface.

licence_note.description: Attribution string required by the provider, if any.

coverage_window.description: Coarse window only, e.g. "trailing 90 days". Never a per-event date range.

method.description: How source records became this assessment.

reconstructable.description: Hard-pinned false. This artifact asserts that the underlying licensed dataset cannot be reconstructed from its contents. If a change would make that untrue, the schema must be changed deliberately — it cannot drift.

model_role.description: Inference-time input only. Licensed content is NOT used as training data.

limitations.description: Known gaps. A thin source window belongs here, not hidden.
